Sophia: Quick weekend poll — sunrise beach cleanup + bagels (7:30am) or board game marathon at Tilted Table (4pm)? :sunrise_over_mountains: :game_die:
Devon: Ooh tough one. I can do board games for sure. :thumbsup:
Anika: Morning’s out for me (got a kiddo party), so board games works best.
Riley: I’m up for the cleanup if someone else can bring coffee. otherwise board games. :coffee: :game_die:
maria: Sunrise beach sounds lovely but I’m heading out of town. vote: board games.
Sophia: Noted — board games currently leading 3/5. Would anyone prefer we try the cleanup next month?
Devon: Yeah next month I can swing the early one. happy to help organize.
Riley: If we do board games, I’ll bring Azul + my portable score sheets.
Anika: I’ll grab snacks if it’s board games — sweet + savory?
Sophia: Sweet + savory works. Also: does anyone have a table we can borrow at Tilted Table?
maria: I can RSVP us a big table if you want — send me the names.
Sophia: Sent a quick DM with names. thanks! :sparkles:
ops-bot: calendar: Created event "Board Game Marathon — Tilted Table" for Sat 4:00 PM in #events.
Sophia: Perfect. Beach cleanup on the backlog for next month. Thanks everyone! :heart:
